name: Bloody Mist Legacy: Black Ice Mirror

system.description:
Black Iron Reflection: Your Ice Mirrors gains 5 DR against damage it isn’t Immune, Resistant or Vulnerable to.

Frost Courier: You gain a rank of Mastery to Athletics. This increases to two ranks at 11th level. Allied creatures that take damage while within 10 feet of an Ice Mirrors, can spend their reaction to fall back into the Ice Mirrors, and teleporting into a space within 5 feet of another Ice Mirrors as if they jumped into one and exited from another.

Black Frost: When a hostile creature destroys an Ice Mirrors you are occupying, the mirror explodes, forcing them to make a Constitution saving throw, becoming Frost Bitten on a failure.
